summary.headline: Session gate now fails closed, but a hardcoded key landed with it.

walkthrough.text: is_active rejects the expired status explicitly.
A module-level API key constant was added.

verdict_reasoning.deciding_factor: A credential is committed in the session module.
verdict_reasoning.failure_mechanism: The constant ships in the wheel and is readable by anyone who installs it.

file_assessments.overview: Adds an explicit expired branch and a module-level constant.
Binary asset replaced; not reviewable as text.

findings.title: Credential committed to the repository
findings.description: A module-level constant holds what looks like an API key.
findings.cause: The value was inlined instead of read from the environment.
findings.fix: Read the value from the environment and rotate the committed one.
findings.failure_scenario: Anyone who installs the package can read the credential.

findings.title: Unknown status still returns active
findings.description: Only the expired status is rejected; every other value falls through to True.
findings.cause: The final branch returns True unconditionally.
findings.fix: Return True only for the known active status.
